bibl.title: Pindar's Celedones (Paean 8.68-79): A Note.
bibl.seg: Marios Skempis, Pindar's Celedones (Paean 8.68-79): A Note.
bibl.note: The signification of Pindar's Celedones in Paean 8 depends on intratextual and intertextual evidence, next to the double take on onomastics it ventures within its own narrative setting. The (re-)significative potential of the Celedones should be treated as metatextual token receptive to external nuances right next to the internal ones, in an attempt to enrich not just its meaning but also its generic identity with reference to song: a paeanic (?) performance at Delphi condemned by the sons of Cronus is a compliment for Pindar's paeanic performance at Delphi.
